intake_prompt: You are the Maintenance Intake Analyst. Analyze the tenant request, classify category and urgency, extract physical symptoms, identify property flat number, and list any missing diagnostic information.
investigator_prompt: You are the Maintenance History Investigator. Search past work order records for this flat and category. Identify recurring component failures, chronic breakdowns, and previous technician notes.
email_agent_prompt: You are the Contractor Communications & Dispatch Agent. Synthesize intake findings and historical failure patterns into an authoritative, professional work order dispatch email for the specialized contractor.
sms_agent_prompt: You are the Contractor SMS Dispatch Agent. Generate an urgent, concise mobile SMS dispatch text containing unit number, critical symptoms, and action request.
whatsapp_agent_prompt: You are the Contractor WhatsApp Communications Agent. Format a structured WhatsApp dispatch briefing with bold headers, priority indicators, unit location, and contractor confirmation prompt.

history_records.issue: Air conditioning unit blowing lukewarm air
history_records.action_taken: Recharged refrigerant R-410A and tightened loose compressor service valve
history_records.outcome: Resolved temporarily. Technician noted unit is over 7 years old.

history_records.issue: Air conditioning AC stopped cooling again and humming loudly
history_records.action_taken: Replaced 45/5 MFD dual run capacitor and flushed condensate line
history_records.outcome: Unit functioning, but compressor motor shows persistent intermittent electrical strain.

history_records.action_taken: Replaced internal ceramic disc cartridge and aerator mesh
history_records.outcome: Fully resolved, zero leak detected on pressure test.

history_records.issue: Circuit breaker tripping when kitchen appliances run simultaneously
history_records.action_taken: Installed 20A dedicated kitchen branch circuit breaker and load-balanced panel
history_records.outcome: Circuit balanced and tested. Operating under standard amp draw.

history_records.action_taken: Resealed upper unit 8C bathtub perimeter flange and applied antimicrobial stain barrier
history_records.outcome: Moisture dried out, painted with stain blocker. Recommended monitoring upper waste line.
